questions.question: List the money columns of the CRJ of a trading business in Grade 9 and state what is recorded in each.
questions.expected_answer: Analysis of receipts: separate amounts making up one deposit. Bank: every amount received and deposited. Sales: selling price of cash sales. Cost of sales: cost price of goods sold (memorandum). Sundry accounts (amount, folio, details): all other receipts, e.g. capital, rent income, loans, interest income, with the account name.

questions.question: Cash sales of R9 000 were made at a mark-up of 50 percent on cost. Show the calculation of cost of sales and state the entries in each CRJ column.
questions.expected_answer: Cost of sales = 9 000 × 100 ÷ 150 = R6 000. Document CRR; details cash sales; bank R9 000; sales R9 000; cost of sales R6 000.

questions.question: The CRJ totals are bank R140 250, sales R27 600, cost of sales R18 400 and sundry R112 650. Show the cross-cast and explain why cost of sales is excluded.
questions.expected_answer: Sales + sundry = 27 600 + 112 650 = R140 250 = bank total, so the journal cross-casts. Cost of sales is excluded because it is a memorandum entry recording stock leaving at cost; no money is received for it.
